kinds.game: Interactive puzzle or game with a win condition or an opponent.
kinds.demo: Interactive demonstration or calculator: you manipulate it, but there is nothing to win.
kinds.illustration: A diagram illustrating a theorem, usually with draggable points.
kinds.helper: Shared library or page chrome, not an applet. Not for porting.

statuses.in-progress: Claimed by a session; see notes for which.
statuses.ported: Live on the site; slug points at the folder.

applets.name: Aliquot
applets.notes: Ported to aliquot/. Opponent is AliquotCanvas.FindFactor verbatim; moves are buttons instead of a typed divisor.

applets.name: BiColorHanoi
applets.notes: Ported as bicolor-hanoi. The applet sets up the bicolor position but its win test and par (2^N-1) are leftovers from the single-tower Hanoi applet it was built from, so the goal comes from the cut-the-knot page instead: both towers monochrome and swapped.
